label: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan)
language_name: Traditional Chinese for Taiwan technical learners
audience: students and software developers in Taiwan
generation_guidance: Use natural, concise, professional Traditional Chinese for Taiwan. The exact approved course title is 使用 OpenShell 和 NemoClaw 建置安全代理程式. Address the learner as 您 when direct address is needed. Follow the shared NVIDIA DLI translation rules and review each deterministic term in context. Preserve product names, code, commands, identifiers, paths, URLs, API fields, model IDs, placeholders, English author attributions such as Yao et al., and cited academic paper titles. Preserve complete model-selector display labels in English, including descriptive suffixes such as recommended, fast, and stronger. Translate learner-facing article titles in recommended-reading lists. Preserve Blueprint in English. Keep established interface labels exactly as displayed. Use Taiwan technical vocabulary and sentence structure; do not treat this locale as a glyph conversion from Simplified Chinese. Avoid literal English syntax, unnecessary English echoes in parentheses, redundant 我們, slogan cadence, and stacked noun phrases.

editorial_examples.source: An agent connects a model to tools, memory, and a routing decision that repeats until its task is done.
editorial_examples.target: 代理程式將模型與工具、記憶和路由決策連線起來，並不斷重複這一過程，直到完成任務。

editorial_examples.source: Calls do not share state. Between requests the server holds nothing for you.
editorial_examples.target: 各次呼叫不共享狀態。兩次請求之間，伺服器不會替您保留任何內容。

editorial_examples.source: Choose the smallest technique that supplies the missing signal.
editorial_examples.target: 選擇能提供缺失訊號的最小可行技術。

review_protocol.native_editorial_signal: NVIDIA 台灣公開用語與合格台灣在地審查者的逐頁審查共同決定措辭。自動產生的文字在審查者接受最終呈現之前仍是草稿。
required_dimensions: Taiwan technical vocabulary and course-wide terminology consistency
consistent learner voice using 您 for direct address
Traditional Chinese punctuation and CJK-English spacing
review_protocol.static_validation_limit: Static checks catch known residue, blocked calques, structure drift, and protected-token defects. They do not certify natural Traditional Chinese for Taiwan.
review_protocol.acceptance_boundary: Accept source and target hashes only after side-by-side rendered review of the exact target by a qualified Taiwan reviewer.

terminology_sources.use: NemoClaw；OpenShell；AI 代理程式；執行階段；模型路由；技能；工作流程；沙箱
參考堆疊；Hermes Agent；LangChain Deep Agents；安全執行階段；沙箱環境
檢索增強生成 (RAG)；大型語言模型 (LLM)；資料擷取；客製化

context_rules.Securing Agents: Use 安全代理程式 for the short course title or brand line. Keep the approved full title 使用 OpenShell 和 NemoClaw 建置安全代理程式 unchanged; generic agent safety still means 代理程式安全.
context_rules.model selector display labels: Preserve the complete English label, including any descriptive suffix after the model name, such as recommended, fast, or stronger. This exception applies only to model-selection dropdown labels; translate the same adjectives normally in prose.
context_rules.Instrumentation: In the helpers menu, where the section contains trace and log, use 追蹤與日誌 instead of 插樁. In prose, translate by function as 監測、檢測 or 可觀測性 rather than forcing one literal term.
context_rules.sandbox: 一般說明使用沙箱；產品介面、指令或識別碼中的 sandbox 保留英文。
context_rules.agent: AI 或軟體 agent 一律使用代理程式；network proxy 才使用代理伺服器。
context_rules.prompt: Use 提示詞 in learner prose; preserve prompt in identifiers, UI labels that must match the source product, and code.
context_rules.runtime: 技術元件使用執行階段；描述程式正在執行時，依句意使用執行期間。
context_rules.workflow: 學習內容使用工作流程；識別碼或產品原文則保留英文。

unfit_phrases.插樁: In this course's helpers menu use 追蹤與日誌; in prose translate instrumentation by its actual function.
unfit_phrases.代理 AI: Use AI 代理程式 or 代理式 AI according to context.
unfit_phrases.工作流程程: Use 工作流程 in this course.
unfit_phrases.這裡將: Rewrite with a natural subject, such as 本節將, or state the action directly.
unfit_phrases.在這裡，我們: Usually remove 在這裡 and use a direct Chinese sentence.
unfit_phrases.超越生成式 AI: Use 從生成式 AI 繼續延伸 or express the actual progression.
unfit_phrases.模型的回應: Prefer 模型回應 when no contrast requires 的.
unfit_phrases.選取在: Use 選取 or 單擊 followed by the object.
unfit_phrases.思維鏈條: Use 思維鏈 or 推理鏈 according to context.
unfit_phrases.護欄: Use 防護機制 in learner prose unless Guardrails is part of a product name.
unfit_phrases.附著到: For Docker attach, keep attach in English.
unfit_phrases.教師模型 generation failed: Executable code text must remain exactly as in the English source unless the repository's runnable-copy contract explicitly localizes it.
unfit_phrases.簡體中文: 本在地化版本使用台灣繁體中文。
unfit_phrases.中國大陸: 本在地化版本面向台灣的技術學習者。
unfit_phrases.智能體: AI 或軟體 agent 請使用代理程式。
unfit_phrases.智慧體: AI 或軟體 agent 請使用代理程式。
unfit_phrases.運行時: 技術元件請使用執行階段。
unfit_phrases.工作流: 學習內容請使用工作流程。
unfit_phrases.配置: 請依語境使用設定或組態。
unfit_phrases.本地: 描述本機執行時請使用本機。
unfit_phrases.響應: 描述模型或服務的 response 時請使用回應。
unfit_phrases.程序: 描述 OS process 時請使用處理程序。
unfit_phrases.倉庫: 描述程式碼 repository 時請使用儲存庫。

editorial_patterns.detail: 中文與中文粗體片段之間不應加入 ASCII 空格。
避免照譯英文指示語；改用自然且明確的主詞。

editorial_patterns.pattern: (?:智慧體式\s*AI|智慧體\s*AI|智慧體迴圈|智能體)
editorial_patterns.detail: 使用代理式 AI、AI 代理程式或代理程式迴圈。

canonical_english_titles: How to Build an AI Agent
How to Build an Agentic RAG Application
How to Build Deep AI Agents
How to Build a Safer Autonomous Agent using OpenClaw

orthography_rules.script: 使用台灣繁體中文，不混入未受保護的簡體字。
orthography_rules.technical_usage: 採用台灣常用的檔案、資料、資訊、軟體、執行階段、工作流程與客製化。

rhythm_rules.sentences: 保持句子簡潔，必要時分句，不照搬英文長句結構。

voice_rules.learner_address: 直接對學習者使用「您」，主詞明確時不重複。
voice_rules.tone: 維持專業、直接且可操作的 NVIDIA DLI 語氣。
